name: Auto sort
description: Upload bank or credit-card statements (CSV, OFX, QFX) and Ledger's AI suggests an account for each transaction; transfers between your accounts are posted once. Optionally reads bills from Ledger's Gmail account (or an IMAP mailbox) on a schedule, tracks them until paid and matches them to statement payments. Needs an admin to allow it under Settings → AI (and Settings → Gmail for bills).

fields.label: Needs review below confidence
fields.help: Suggestions below this confidence (0 to 1) are marked Needs review.

fields.label: Read bills from
fields.help: Gmail needs this module allowed to read mail under Settings → Gmail.

fields.label: Check email for bills every (minutes)
fields.help: 0 turns scheduled checks off; Check email now on the Bills tab always works.

fields.label: Statements in email
fields.help: With Stage, bank and card statements found in email (CSV, OFX or QFX attachments, or PDF statements when Ledger's AI is Claude) are staged on the Statements tab. You approve and post the transactions yourself.

fields.label: Gmail search for bills
fields.help: Optional, e.g. label:bills (with a Gmail filter that labels bills). Empty: any of the keywords below.

fields.label: Bill keywords
fields.default: invoice, bill, statement, amount due, balance due, payment due, due date, receipt, pre-authorized, autopay, facture
fields.help: Comma-separated. Only emails containing one of these are sent to the AI. Empty: every email the search finds.

fields.label: IMAP server
fields.help: Only for IMAP, e.g. imap.fastmail.com, outlook.office365.com, imap.mail.me.com, or 127.0.0.1 for Proton Bridge.

fields.label: IMAP password
fields.help: Usually an app password. Or set CATEGORIZER_IMAP_PASSWORD in /etc/ledger/ledger.env.

fields.label: Accounts payable account code
fields.help: Optional. A liability account, e.g. 2000. Approving a bill then posts it there, and its bank payment clears it. Empty: bills are only tracked.
